scope: Two bounded claims for later Chapter7 writing; not final chapter review.

claims.claim: 2019 US secondary-school study observed grade benefits among lower-achieving students and effects depended on supportive school/peer context; it does not establish guaranteed effects for all university learners or that neuroplasticity alone proves intervention efficacy.

The 50/10/40 pie was an approximate speculative framework rather than a formula for partitioning one individual's happiness; later author revisit agrees with important critiques and acknowledges the activity estimate may overstate effects. Publication has online2019 and journal2021 distinction.
